verdict_rules.definition: For every (test, cell, metric), output WIN / TIE / LOSS for OCD-Mix against each baseline
verdict_rules.win_criteria: Holm-adjusted paired CI excludes 0 in our favour AND (for delay or width) both methods control FAR / coverage
verdict_rules.loss_criteria: Holm-adjusted paired CI excludes 0 in baseline favour AND (for delay or width) both methods control FAR / coverage
verdict_rules.matched_far_rule: Delay comparisons are made only at matched FAR (Tier 2) or at matched ARL
verdict_rules.tier1_rule: Tier 1 results reported separately as 'out-of-the-box robustness'
verdict_rules.far_control_rule: A method controls FAR if its null FAR 95% CI contains 0.05 (Tier 2)

CWS-1.description: iid N(0,I_p), p in {100, 500}, s in {2, round(sqrt(p)), p}, theta in {2, 1, 0.5}, beta in {2*theta, theta, theta/2}

CWS-2.description: p = 100, s in {5, 50}, theta in {1, 2}, shapes uniform / j^-1/2 / j^-1

CWS-3.description: ROC curves (P(S_hat U {j_hat} supseteq S) vs P(S_hat subseteq S_beta)) varying d1 at ell=0, coverage vs c for M4 and M1 (c grid 0.1-1.0)

CWS-4.description: Offline CI of Kaul et al. after an alarm on CWS-1 grid

CWS-5.description: D1 CDC weekly deaths as in CWS Sec 4.4 (seasonal curve bandwidth 20 days, sqrt transform, train end 29 June 2019)

MP-1.description: Scenarios S1-S3, T in {150, 300}, p in {3, 5}, 200 reps

MP-2.description: Single change at T/2 with X_t = 0.3 X_{t-1} + eps_t, mu=1_p, p in {2, 3}, T in {100, 200, 300}, alpha in {0.01, 0.05}

MP-3.description: Kernel and bandwidth robustness for M8, runtime for M8 and M1 at T in {150, 300}, p=3

MP-4.description: D2 FRED daily closes SP500, DJIA, NASDAQCOM. Single-change online methods use m0=50 with restart (blackout of ell)

RFF-1.description: Runtime per insert and total for n up to 250000 (d=1) and for d in {20, 50}, r in {10, 50, 100, 500, 1000} vs M1 and M3

RFF-2.description: P=N(0_20, I_20), Q in {mixed_normal, laplace, uniform}, 64 pre-change samples, 100 reps, ARL in {1e2, 1e3, 1e4}

RFF-3.description: D4 MNIST digit 0 -> digits 1-9 (d=784, drop zero-variance pixels with eps=1e-6), same protocol as RFF-2

RFF-4.description: D3 HASC walking -> staying (skip 1596 walking samples, 100 walk + 100 stay, 10 datasets, alpha=0.1)

OWN-1.description: VAR(1), phi in {0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8}, p=50, T=5000, m0=1000, b=2500, s in {2, 5, 50}, effects {1.0, 1.5}, >=1000 streams/cell, plus non-diagonal VAR(1) stress

reproduction_gates.RG3: RFF-4 RFF-MMD row within 25% of 21.86 on delay and +-1 on too-early/miss
